# PokéTruc

> PokéTruc is a free, fan-made, ad-free catalogue of language-exclusive Pokémon Trading Card Game (TCG) illustrations — cards whose artwork was only ever printed in a single language or region. It lists 569 such cards across 140 Generation 1 Pokémon, published from 1996 to 2026.

The site has 5 interface languages (English, French, Japanese, Korean, Chinese). Each Pokémon has its own page listing its language-exclusive cards grouped by card language, with year, artist, and a source link (e.g. Bulbapedia, PokeBeach) where available. Card languages in the collection: 437 Japanese, 74 English, 43 Chinese, 4 Indonesian, 3 Korean, 2 German, 2 Spanish, 1 French, 1 Italian, 1 Portuguese, 1 Polish. Created by Begooderrr (https://www.reddit.com/user/Begooderrr/); source code at https://github.com/amaurybegood/PokeTruc-Web.

## Main pages

- [Pokédex (home)](https://poketruc.com/): searchable grid of all Generation 1 Pokémon, filterable by card language.
- [Info / About](https://poketruc.com/info/): what the project is, plus credits and sources.

## Optional

- [XML sitemap](https://poketruc.com/sitemap.xml): every URL, in all 5 languages, with hreflang annotations.
